title: High Noon Fortune
prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Input image 1 is High Noon Fortune catalogue key art. Change ONLY framing. Uniformly scale the complete central coach, luggage, lasso, title plaque, sheriff star and nugget group down to 70% of its current size and center it in the same true 2:1 canvas. Extend the existing frontier town, turquoise sky and dusty street naturally around the smaller group. Preserve exact full title "High Noon Fortune", all gold/turquoise western letterforms, red/gold stagecoach details, plausible wheels, lasso shape, lighting, palette and premium illustration style. The complete coach roof/luggage, all title letters and lasso must fit central 80% width / 70% height, with at least 15% open background above and below the essential group. No added words, human figures, horses, weapons, UI, slogans, logos or watermark. One opaque image only.
initialGenerationPrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: original premium illustrated slot-game catalogue title card.
Primary request: one polished original High Noon Fortune title card preserving its frontier-town, stagecoach and golden-lasso theme.
Scene/backdrop: a warm golden-hour frontier main street with weathered timber storefronts, red-rock mesas, hints of desert cactus and a turquoise-blue sky. Storefronts have NO readable signs or writing. Spacious depth with a soft dust haze.
Subject: a compact ornate red-and-gold wooden stagecoach in three-quarter view, black leather roof, warm brass lanterns, luggage strapped on top, four plausible wooden spoked wheels. A looping golden rope lasso sweeps behind/around the coach as a restrained compositional arc, with a small silver sheriff star and a few gold nuggets as secondary details. No horses, driver, human characters or weapons.
Style/medium: premium professionally illustrated western-adventure game key art, polished painterly wood, leather, brass and dust textures, clean silhouette and controlled lighting. Rust red, dark brown, sandstone gold and turquoise accents. No photorealism or explosion.
Composition/framing: TRUE wide 2:1 landscape. Large title and stagecoach balance across a compact central arrangement; lasso adds a flowing arc without crossing lettering. Complete title, coach and essential lasso loop must fit inside x=15%–85%, y=20%–80%, with generous quiet background margins. All essential art inside central 80% width / 70% height. Title clear at 256x128.
Text (verbatim): "High Noon Fortune". Exactly these full three words once in substantial western slab-serif display letters, two or three compact lines allowed. Warm gold/ivory with a subtle dark-brown shadow and restrained turquoise detailing. Every word prominent, no tiny subtitle.
Constraints: no extra words, wanted posters, slogans, payout promises, numbers, currency labels, reels, spin buttons, fake UI, other brands, logos or watermark. No unrelated cultural/religious symbols. Opaque background. One image only.
